plan.archetype: Flexible poison scaling with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Improve damage to cross the 160-HP stun threshold promptly. Establish scaling, reliable Weak, and efficient block for one-card Ringing turns; bring defensive potions.
plan.summary: Take efficient attacks first, then build sustained damage and stronger defense. Follow the chosen pack rather than forcing poison. Remove weak starters, upgrade core cards, and enter elites with adequate health and potions.

plan.archetype: Efficient poison scaling with skill discounts and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal at both campfires. Cross the 160-HP stun threshold quickly with poison and efficient attacks; secure reliable Weak and strong single-card block.
